validation_scope.basis: Code capabilities and offline synthetic tests, not deployment state or full firmware acceptance
validation_scope.maintainer_question: not posted; not included in this contribution
validation_scope.older_ha_compatibility: Minimum HA 2025.7.0 (Python >=3.13.2); offline required-mode suite and actual-HA contracts tested on HA 2025.7.0 / Python 3.13.14 and HA 2026.10.4 / Python 3.14.7. Not every intermediate release or live firmware path is tested.

coverage_note: 47 inventory topics, not 47 entities. Implemented means code exists, not firmware acceptance. HOLD can coexist with an implemented subset. No host install status is tracked. Firmware install, approve, delete and push settings are not exposed.

entries.name: Mode-aware cartridge capacity
entries.source: cartridge.py: reported maximum first; regular-cartridge rating only with known mode/manual. Missing and maintenance cartridges have no guessed capacity.

entries.name: Configuration write safety
entries.source: configuration.py and configuration_lock.py: scoped payloads, per-device serialization, fresh preservation reads where required.
entries.next_proof: Vendor partial/nested PUT merge semantics are not proven by local serialization or acknowledgement.

entries.name: Idle progress display
entries.source: operation_status.py: connected idle with explicit error clearance displays 0 for absent/sentinel progress; malformed wire records remain quarantined.

entries.name: Cat / Manual / Time mode selector
entries.source: select.py: paired mode/manual writes, not the app presentation enum.

entries.name: Activity Data / Diary read pipeline
entries.source: activity.py and history_coordinator.py: separate history reader.
entries.next_proof: Per-cat attribution requires visit pet identity evidence.

entries.name: Panel auto-lock timeout control
entries.source: number.py auto_lock_timeout: 0/5/10/15/20/25/30 minutes, autoLock seconds only. App #18273/#18286; addDelay is a refresh wait, not a PUT key.
entries.next_proof: Firmware write acceptance; pending hold is not confirmation.

entries.name: Cat activation delay control
entries.source: number.py cat_activation_delay: 5/10/15/20/25/30 minutes; exact dndFrom/dndTo/catDelay payload, fresh supported DND pair preserved. App #18377.
entries.next_proof: Prior HA/app round-trip verification does not establish full raw coupled-field preservation, which remains unmeasured.

entries.name: Cleaning history and abort outcomes
entries.source: history.py and activity.py aborted_cycles; aware machineTS fallback for naive RTC.
entries.next_proof: Not every nonzero abort integer is a classified outcome.

entries.name: Do Not Disturb window
entries.source: dnd_actions.py: registered native action; authorization before I/O, explicit zone/date, fresh catDelay preservation read.
entries.next_proof: App empty-string off/readback is evidence of encoding, not integration PUT acceptance or recurring firmware DST execution.

entries.name: Explicit history window
entries.source: history.py: explicit startTime, seven-local-day request window.
entries.next_proof: No-parameter window and retention are unverified.

entries.name: Schedule display and editor
entries.source: schedule_actions.py: native set_schedule action. Device-page editor/local schedule entity deferred; legacy schedule.py fragments remain nonsendable.
entries.next_proof: Schedule-only sibling preservation and firmware DST execution remain unverified.

entries.name: Visits: daily count, last visit, duration and diary
entries.source: activity.py: attributed count, last visit, duration and bounded-window diaries; unknown coverage is not zero.
entries.next_proof: No per-cat attribution without verified visit identity.

entries.name: Volume control
entries.source: number.py: volumeLevel only, integers 1–7.

entries.name: Cartridge type diagnostic
entries.source: reported_config.py and sensor.py cartridge_type: explicit integer tagType 0/1/3; not a control.

entries.name: Reported timezone diagnostic
entries.source: reported_config.py and sensor.py reported_timezone: explicit configuration string, no guessed zone or DST conversion.
entries.next_proof: Not a writable timezone selector or verified schedule conversion input.

entries.name: History coverage and retention
entries.source: history.py coverage attributes; complete_history is always false.
entries.next_proof: Retention and pagination remain unknown; no invented has_more.

entries.name: Notification events
entries.source: read_information.py: one account reader; integer enum only; types 101–106 discarded.
entries.next_proof: Nonempty authoritative live notification item; synthetic fixtures are not acceptance.

entries.name: Account notification preference
entries.source: No preference switch.
entries.next_proof: Establish whether pushEnabled is account-wide.

entries.name: Pet profile/identity information
entries.source: Profiles counted in history diagnostics; no pet identity/weight sensor.
entries.next_proof: Profile weight is not live weight or visit ownership.

entries.name: Version/documentation consistency
entries.source: Manifest and README declare v1.0.1. Minimum HA 2025.7.0 requires Python >=3.13.2; actual-HA offline contracts cover that release and HA 2026.10.4. Docs describe code behavior, not host deployment.
entries.next_proof: Remote CI and live firmware acceptance are not established by local offline tests.

entries.name: Account metadata
entries.source: No identity or PII sensors.
entries.next_proof: No account-metadata entity planned.

entries.name: Cat sensitivity control
entries.source: Read-only cat_sensitivity sensor; no number or invented range.
entries.next_proof: Corroborated app control and supported range.

entries.name: DST fields diagnostics
entries.source: reported_config.py: explicit dstFrom/dstTo in timezone attributes, semantics unverified.
entries.next_proof: Device execution semantics, not a control.

entries.name: Dome/accessory diagnostic
entries.source: No accessory entity.
entries.next_proof: Physical meaning and ownership.

entries.name: Devices added after setup
entries.source: Entities are created at setup. New devices require integration reload; removed devices become unavailable.
entries.next_proof: Dynamic device lifecycle not implemented.

entries.name: Estimated cycle finish/time remaining
entries.source: No remaining-time estimate.
entries.next_proof: Device-reported remaining time; configured duration is not telemetry.

entries.name: Other device/configuration diagnostics
entries.source: sensor.py: explicit reported measurements; binary_sensor.py: low heater/fan shutter disabled by default. No unexplained extra numeric sensors.
entries.next_proof: No Download diagnostics hook or broad raw payload export.

entries.name: Firmware availability / release notes / install
entries.source: read_sensors.py: attributed type-24 announced version and notes for known versions. Device-page sw_version refreshes on reload; note attribution follows device coordinator. No UpdateEntity or install action.
entries.next_proof: Live authoritative type-24 item. No item means unknown, not up to date.

entries.name: Device language
entries.source: No language selector.
entries.next_proof: Desired versus actual language values.

entries.name: Cycle phase / start countdown
entries.source: No phase or countdown sensor; progress is not phase.
entries.next_proof: Verified phase/countdown field.

entries.name: Status endpoint compatibility
entries.source: client.py: device-list GET is the polling path; no dependency on separate status endpoint.

entries.name: Cat present / occupancy
entries.source: No occupancy entity.
entries.next_proof: Verified sens telemetry; missing is not false.

entries.name: Pump/heater/water hardware settings
entries.source: Calibration and hardware settings unexposed.
entries.next_proof: No user controls planned without evidence.

entries.name: Pause / resume / stage commands
entries.source: Pause posts state 2, Resume state 3, Abort state 4 and does not replace Stop. Buttons enabled by default only on new registration; existing registry choices preserved. Normal-cycle use owner-verified. HOLD is for unproven fault/stage semantics, not absence of controls.
entries.next_proof: Fault resume during water-fill fault, cartridge allowance effects, and natural-pause render remain unverified.

entries.name: Liquid level / used solution volume
entries.source: Remaining cycles are not measured liquid volume.
entries.next_proof: A measured volume; no guessed maintenance volumes or catalogue.

entries.name: Special / no-scoop cycle
entries.source: No-scoop posts state 129 only after the fwVersion 8.5.81 gate; shared writer enforces it. Enabled by default only on new registration. Normal-cycle wash without scoop owner-verified. HOLD is for unproven effects, not absence of the button.
entries.next_proof: Cartridge allowance and physical finishing-cycle equivalence; not state 4 or EXTRA_WASH.

entries.name: Other endpoint catalogue entries
entries.source: Catalogue is not HA entities; destructive, network and account-management operations excluded.
entries.next_proof: No broad endpoint exposure planned.

entries.name: Vacuum/valve domain model
entries.source: No vacuum/valve platform.
entries.next_proof: A verified domain contract; predecessor stop/pause mappings conflict.

entries.name: Extra dry, wash, and shake
entries.source: switch.py: extra dry/wash/shake. Wash/shake require reported binaryElements.
entries.next_proof: Vendor nested binaryElements sibling-merge semantics remain unverified.

entries.name: Extra dry
entries.source: switch.py extra_dry.

entries.name: Extra shake
entries.source: switch.py extra_shake; requires binaryElements.
entries.next_proof: Nested sibling preservation remains unverified.

entries.name: Extra wash
entries.source: switch.py extra_wash; requires binaryElements.
entries.next_proof: Nested sibling preservation remains unverified.

entries.name: Serial, MAC, BLE, and connectivity sensors
entries.source: sensor.py network_type and device registry serial/MAC fields. No separate BLE identity sensor.

entries.name: Panel lock
entries.source: switch.py panel_lock writes childLock; distinct from auto-lock timeout.

entries.name: Status sensors already in current
entries.source: sensor.py: operation state/progress/error/status, last clean, explicit total cycles and remaining count. Absent values are not fabricated zero.

entries.name: Start cleaning
entries.source: button.py start_cleaning, explicit connected report required.

entries.name: Stop cleaning
entries.source: button.py stop_cleaning, state 0; distinct from Abort state 4.
